title: Missed Anniversary Reminder Near Misses
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sharedcalendar:event
| search event_type="anniversary" near_miss=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as near_misses by _time reminder_type
| sort - _time
description: Tracks anniversary near misses over time and breaks it out by reminder type.
value: Near misses matter because they show the reminder system barely working before it actually fails.
implementation: Send anniversary near misses events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of anniversary near misses by reminder type.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how anniversary near misses changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
